item.text:
Diagnosis: The requested defect is confined to dashboard presentation/layout, but the packet contains no current source, dirty diff, handoff contents, `LEARNING.md`, failing render evidence, or existing test results. Therefore the exact CSS/DOM root cause and changed-file set cannot yet be established from this sealed evidence.

Intended boundary: After inspecting those materials, add a failing focused layout regression, then make the smallest dashboard HTML/CSS/JS change needed to produce compact equal-height endpoint cards, contained board/lane/task content, intentional wrapping or ellipsis, and bounded responsive scrolling. Preserve polling, controls, accessibility labels, selection behavior, status semantics, and all task/endpoint data. Do not touch worker/controller code, APIs, runtime DB, assignment/capacity logic, manifests, or recovery behavior.

Verification plan:

- Prove the regression fails for the demonstrated overflow/density condition, then passes after the patch.
- Run focused dashboard/UI tests and relevant static checks.
- Render desktop and narrow viewports and capture browser evidence confirming alignment, containment, scrolling, labels, controls, and selected-task behavior.
- Record exact commands/results, loaded source/cache identity, files changed, remaining visual limitations, and preservation of pre-existing dirty work in the required role report.

Safety constraints: No retry, replay, resume, or mutation of the separate health-recovery task; no Git reset/stash/clean/branch switch/commit/push; no overwrite of unrelated changes. Existing operational semantics and durable task/endpoint identity remain intact.

Intended route: `REVIEW` after the bounded implementation and all focused plus browser-render verification succeed. Route to `TEST` instead only if the required browser/reload/environment boundary remains independently unproven. Never route directly to `DONE`; that is PLAN-only.
